reviews.text:
He STOLE from us!! DO NOT USE HIM!!
Paid for a remodel but he never completed the job, 68000!. Never installed the pool equipment pool and spa . He said he didn’t have any money to buy these. That he had to wait on his next customer so he would have some money to purchase our pool equipment that we already paid for. Stopped answering the phone. We have spoken with others and are going to have a CLASS ACTOON LAWSUIT AGAINST HIM!! He is a CROOK!  Can’t post any negative review about him on FB because he will just delete it. If you want to talk to me regarding this review,, respond to this review and I will contact you!
reviews.author: KAREN STEELE

reviews.text:
**Buyer Beware**

Joe Castro is a basic contractor who does odd jobs…not a buttoned up high end pool company.  He’s unprofessional and extremely unreliable, especially with customers who have already paid him in full.  Once he receives money for your job, he will move his attention to his next sale.
He re-modeled my pool and left for an entire month when the pool / plaster needed the most attention.  I have numerous examples of him not doing what he said he would do and leaving me hanging with zero assistance.  Joe will just disappear and or lie to you when you ask him questions.  He and his phone alone is his company…nobody else to turn to if you have issues.  I spent thousands of dollars for my re-model and fully regret using his company.
I never leave reviews and wanted to work well with Joe because he is a local business, but I was fooled thinking his company was more than it is.  I should have gone with a more reputable and professional business.  He let me down and now I’m having to get another company to service and fix issues he created.  Save yourself the grief and use a different company.
reviews.author: Micheal Peterman

reviews.text: I have had 2 pools built by Castro pools and 1 replaster.  Joe Castro has always done a professional job with very competitive prices.  Both pool builds and plaster job were completed on and usually before the timeline schedule.  Joe has attended required schools on plaster and pool care and shared the information with us. recommend!
reviews.author: Richard Care

reviews.text: Castro and his team were fantastic to work with.  They installed all new equipment for my existing pool as well as laid and sealed new coping stones.  The pool looks and performs the best it ever has!  Thank-you, Castro, for your excellent customer service, and for making my pool a place my family can really enjoy!
reviews.author: Doug Bailey

reviews.text: Took bids for a pool remodel,plaster tile and coping ,had a friend recommend Castro pools he had a good experience,I wish I could say the same ,they matched my lowest bid For a complete remodel in April of 2018 . The job ended up taking over a month to complete and should of been done in a week, Castro turned on my pool to drain and left  , my wife came home and turned off the pump ,running dry this was the start of a bunch of mistakes and excuses,my pool was left without water for over three weeks and water started leaking through the plaster around my lights ,the plaster crew rushed spraying and troweling the plaster ,tile on steps were crooked and plaster was uneven and had splotches ,not enough coping was ordered and had to use coping that was not the same ,to finish ,the tile was cut with a grinder and the edges are chipped ,quality seems Not a priority, I would not recommend this company to anyone,Joe Castro is a very nice man and seems to care however there is always an excuse for anything that doesn’t work out right . Joe told me he is a certified diamond brite contractor which is not true ,and. Can be verified through diamond  brite ,he uses a contractor that is certified,and if there is any problem the contractor has to correct it .my review is based on my experience this remodel took way to long and too many mistakes were made by someone that has been in this business as long as Joe has and the quality of his work is only as good as you will accept ,The home owner should not have to make sure everything has been finished correctly,that defeats the purpose of hiring a good contractor and trusting that he will over see the job and quality that represents his company. I hope this review helps some from making the same mistake I made .
reviews.author: Texxx Sun

reviews.text: Castro's pool has worked on our pool over the past several years. Has always done what he says she will do for a fare price. I highly recommend him for all your pool and general contracting needs.
reviews.author: B

reviews.text: Only because 0 was not an option! I am so disappointed after countless attempts to simply get them to come back and do what was promised 125 and 75 service fee and no call! No call and no show! Took my money and did not complete the job! I am handicap and needed for my health! They assured me to return Sat morning its Wednesday and they didn’t apologize or compensate! I have pictures of my pool! This company is not reputable!
reviews.author: Kourtney Lowery

Mr. Castro start building my play pool 2 weeksago and planning to finish in 2 more weeks. Very detail on all the work.

data.summary: The review profile is highly concerning. While some positive reviews exist, the negative reviews are numerous, detailed, and describe a severe, repeated pattern of taking deposits/full payment and then failing to complete work, becoming unresponsive, and delivering poor quality. The complete absence of middle-ground (3-4 star) reviews is a major red flag, indicating a business that either delights or severely disappoints, with strong evidence pointing towards unreliable and potentially fraudulent practices. The positive reviews, especially older ones, may be authentic past successes but do not outweigh the severe, recent allegations.
fake_signals: Polarized review distribution (only 5-star and 1-2 star, no 3-4 star)
Multiple 5-star reviews from 8 years ago clustered together
Generic praise in some 5-star reviews lacking specific details
Owner name 'Joe Castro' appears in both positive and negative reviews, but negative reviews contain far more specific, credible allegations.
authentic_signals: Specific, detailed complaints with amounts ($68,000), timelines, and concrete failures
Emotional authenticity in negative reviews (anger, betrayal)
Some positive reviews mention specific projects (replaster, equipment install) and timelines
Complaints show a consistent pattern of taking money and failing to complete work or provide adequate service.
complaint_patterns: Failure to complete work after payment
data.discrepancy_explanation: Significant discrepancy between Google HQ rating (4.8) and Google Local rating (3.0). The Local reviews show a stark, polarized split with no middle-ground reviews, suggesting potential review manipulation or a business with highly inconsistent service quality.
